environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed in us-east-1, invoked via API Gateway (HTTP API, no authorization). The Lambda has an execution role with DynamoDB read access and CloudWatch Logs write. The API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abc123.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod/reports/generate. No WAF, no request validation, no VPC attachment. The function processes report template expressions from any authenticated or unauthenticated caller.
